infobox.usage: Unlocks the cabin of a police truck on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Police truck cabin key (Police) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens a cabin of the abandoned police transport truck.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The police truck is located on the road west of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Intelligence folder spawn in front of the seat
- Kalashnikov AK-103 7.62x39 assault rifle spawn on the seat
